wo-jpfa-JR4927.d:
Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Content Development

• Develop and manage digital learning content, including presentation materials, videos, animations, infographics, and other multimedia content for training programs.
• Translate training and business requirements into engaging and user-friendly digital content.
• Support the development and implementation of digital learning solutions to enhance participant engagement and learning effectiveness.
• Maintain and continuously improve digital content based on feedback, technology trends, and business requirements.

2. Multimedia & Production

• Plan, coordinate, and supervise the production of multimedia content for training programs and corporate events.
• Oversee video production, photography, graphic design, animation, audio-visual materials, and other digital assets.
• Ensure all production deliverables meet quality, timeline, branding, and technical standards.
• Coordinate with internal creative teams and external production vendors when required.

3. Training Center Digital Support

• Support the implementation of digital technology and multimedia solutions for training activities at the Training Center.
• Ensure training rooms and learning facilities are supported with appropriate digital and audio-visual solutions.
• Explore and implement new technologies that can improve the learning experience and operational efficiency.
• Provide technical coordination and troubleshooting support for digital learning and multimedia requirements.

4. Corporate Event Production

• Coordinate digital and multimedia requirements for corporate events, including presentations, videos, live streaming, LED displays, audio-visual systems, and other event technology.
• Work closely with event teams to ensure smooth execution of production activities before, during, and after events.
• Manage production schedules, technical requirements, and coordination with vendors and event partners.
• Conduct post-event evaluation and identify opportunities for improvement.

5. Project & Vendor Management

• Manage digital development and production projects from planning through execution and completion.
• Prepare production timelines, work plans, budgets, and resource requirements.
• Coordinate with external vendors, production houses, creative agencies, and technology providers.
• Monitor vendor performance, deliverables, quality, and project timelines.

6. Digital Innovation & Continuous Improvement

• Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies such as AI, digital learning platforms, interactive media, automation, and other digital solutions.
• Propose innovative approaches to improve training delivery, participant engagement, and corporate event experiences.
• Monitor industry trends and best practices in digital learning, multimedia production, and event technology.
• Support digitalization initiatives within the Training Center and corporate event activities.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Digital Media, Multimedia, Communication, Information Technology, Design, Event Management, or a related field.
• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in digital content development, multimedia production, learning technology, event production, or a related field.
• Experience in managing multimedia production, digital content, or corporate events.
• Good understanding of audio-visual technology, video production, graphic design, and digital content development.
• Experience working with creative teams, production houses, technology vendors, or event organizers.
• Strong project management, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders.
• Creative, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
• Familiarity with digital learning platforms, LMS, AI tools, video editing, or other digital production technologies is an advantage.
• Willing to support training and corporate events based on business requirements, including activities outside regular working hours when necessary.

wo-jpfa-JR5164.d:
PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk mencari staf pemeliharaan (Maintenance) yang berdedikasi untuk peternakan ayam broiler guna mengawasi serta melaksanakan pemeliharaan, perbaikan, dan memastikan berfungsinya mesin, peralatan, dan fasilitas kandang ayam broiler secara optimal. Peran ini sangat penting untuk menjamin lingkungan yang aman, efisien, dan sangat produktif bagi produksi ayam broiler, serta mendukung standar operasional perusahaan secara langsung.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan:

* Melakukan pemeliharaan preventif rutin dan perbaikan darurat pada semua peralatan peternakan, termasuk sistem pemberian pakan otomatis, jalur air minum, kipas ventilasi, pemanas, dan instalasi kelistrikan.

* Memeriksa, memelihara, dan mengelola peralatan pengondisian serta sistem pengomposan untuk memastikan tingkat kelembapan dan kebersihan yang optimal di dalam kandang ayam broiler.

* Menangani masalah teknis (troubleshooting) terkait mekanikal, elektrikal, dan sistem perpipaan di seluruh fasilitas peternakan dengan sigap guna meminimalkan waktu henti operasional (*downtime*).

* Memantau sistem utilitas, termasuk generator cadangan dan sistem penyediaan air, untuk memastikan operasional tetap berjalan tanpa gangguan.

* Berkolaborasi dengan tim manajemen peternakan untuk merencanakan jadwal pemeliharaan serta memberikan rekomendasi terkait peningkatan atau penggantian peralatan.

* Memastikan seluruh kegiatan pemeliharaan mematuhi standar ketat perusahaan mengenai biosekuriti, kesehatan, keselamatan kerja, dan lingkungan (HSE).

* Mencatat kegiatan pemeliharaan, inventaris peralatan, dan penggunaan suku cadang secara akurat.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan:

1. Minimal lulusan Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, atau bidang teknis terkait lainnya.

2 Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun dalam operasional pemeliharaan, diutamakan di industri peternakan unggas, produksi ternak, atau lingkungan pertanian skala besar.

3 Memiliki pengetahuan teknis yang kuat mengenai sistem kelistrikan, PLC, perpipaan, dan mesin-mesin peternakan.

4 Memahami operasional peternakan ayam broiler dan sistem kandang otomatis (*closed-house system*) menjadi nilai tambah yang signifikan.

5 Memiliki kemampuan *troubleshooting* yang terbukti dengan pendekatan proaktif dalam memecahkan masalah.

6 Mampu bekerja secara efektif, baik secara mandiri maupun sebagai bagian dari tim di lingkungan peternakan yang dinamis.

7 Bersedia ditempatkan di lokasi peternakan perusahaan serta bersedia bekerja dengan jam kerja fleksibel atau sistem *on-call* (siap dipanggil) sesuai kebutuhan.
